ocr_text:
(FILED: NEW YORK COUNTY CLERK 09/27/2018 04:16 PM INDEX NO. 654791/2018
NYSCEF DOC. NO. 3 RECEIVED NYSCEF: 09/27/2018

WHEREFORE it is respectfully requested that judgment be entered in favor of Plaintiff
OPEH LLC and against Defendants Michael E. Bleich and Alexis K. Bleich in the amount of
$2,233,007 with interest from September 17, 2018, calculated at the Promissory Note’s default
rate of 15% per annum ($930.42 per diem), until paid, and the accrued unpaid interest in the
amount of $155,070, but in no event less than the amount of $2,388,077, plus OPEH’s cost of
collection including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys’ fees and the costs of this action,

and such other and further relief that this Court deems just and proper.

ane

Sworn to before me this
day of September, 2018.

Notary Public
RHONDA L CAMPBELL

NOTARY PUBLIC-STATE OF NEW YORK

No. 01CA6254059
Qualified in Kings County
My Commission Expires January 09, 2020
